scope: re-audit from the first order/absolute-number intuition through v1.13 and prior Batch32
authority_rules: Never infer Promotion from compression alone.
Never infer primitive from single-target prediction.
Exact/approximate closure must be context and operation aware.
Order depth is admissibility-relative and subject to flattening.
G-Rise is language-relative until an invariant definability notion is proved.
Context-free compressed absolute number is rejected in general.
Finite upper state is optional, not guaranteed.
FAIL and counterexamples are authority, not discarded.
